scientific_question: Does norm-weighting observed clustered strong-margin 16D data by exp(-||x||²) improve complete physical BPD mechanism recovery over the original unweighted Gaussian zero-mass objective, holding sigma=0.15, original QR, 2048 training boards and nine full-angle Givens sweeps constant? Is the planted basis favored over the predeclared anchored-pair 45deg remix in independent weighted objective diagnostics?

source.generator: EXACT PD12 rotation_for_seed, initial_random_basis, support_banks, sample_batch, physical_model and evaluate_family; all unchanged
source.shared_training_pool: Every learned arm sees the same 2048 observed boards and first QR. No latent support, true Q, cardinality or heldout samples in optimizer.

objective.unweighted: max mean_over_rows_and_observed_x exp(-0.5*(xV/sigma)^2), identical to PD12 global37
objective.weight_formula: w(x)=exp(-lambda*sum_{j=1}^{16} x_j^2), computed on observed dense x only, lambda=1.0 for weighted arms; lambda=0 for controls
objective.weight_normalization: Per-seed fixed sum weights, no clipping, thresholding, fitting, label access or learned weight
objective.weight_orthogonality: ||x||² is invariant under latent orthogonal Q, so w computed without latent Q
objective.pair_order: all 120 i<j in lexicographic order, repeated 9 times
objective.orthonormal_factors: V 16x16 orthogonal, U=V.T; double Givens updates
objective.sample_weight_extra_cost: separately record norm calculation, exp(-norm^2), weighted reductions, wall time

population_analytic_witness.method: exact PD12 support enumeration and 1D/2D uniform-amplitude Gauss-Legendre quadrature; posthoc PD14 motivation, not a prescored result

scoring.objective_consistency_gate: On at least 30/32 independently generated diagnostic pools, lambda=0 at sigma=.15 must favor anchored 45-degree four-pair remix over Q while lambda=1 at same sigma favors Q over remix
scoring.secondary: weighted_narrow vs uniform_narrow, narrow vs wide within each weight law; descriptive paired counts, no additional significance gate
